question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series based on the English alphabetical order?

ABZ, CDX, EFV, GHT, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First and second letter → (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter → (2) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​​So,

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9620ad87cee135cfce58718df41e2754c591e4fcb13dc6f97c987d0a7de03ea.png] 

Hence, "**IJR**" is the correct answer.
